text_block_list.text:
"Having entered the Classic Year, Vivlos 
gradually ramped up her training intensity 
aiming for the Tiara route."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Haaaah~~~~...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: No, I'm okay... Just one mooore...!

Naturally, as the intensity of training 
increases, so does fatigue. I assumed that 
was the reason for Vivlos's exhaustion as 
well.
However...—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: —...Ugh... Mmm... *wheeze*... *wheeze*...

Though Vivlos seems unaware of it, she's 
rubbing her stomach, and her breathing 
sounds different than usual.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...*wheeze*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... Hey, Trainy, maybe we could take 
a little breather...?
choice_data_list: No, let's stop here for today.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list:
Let's get you checked out in the nurse's 
office.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm okay, you know? Just need to rest 
a bit."
choice_data_list: Let's make sure things are fine.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Still—
choice_data_list: Could you do me a favor?
Can you do me a favor?

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... It might be better to have it 
checked out properly at a hospital.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Repeated stomach aches, abnormal breathing 
sounds... It's possible she is suffering 
from multiple symptoms.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
It seems best to wait and see for a while. 
In my medical opinion... it will take at 
least six months for a full recovery.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Six months, you say... Then it really 
is..."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Huh...
choice_data_list:
I'm sorry I didn't notice anything was 
wrong.

text_block_list.text:
Being too naive to take the warning signs 
seriously, and lacking the reliability to 
make Vivlos feel she could confide in 
me... This happened because of me.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...No, that's not it. You see, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —Vivlos!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Big sis? Why...?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Your Trainer got in touch with me. More 
importantly, are you okay?!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'm calm now. I'm okay...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
That's right, thank goodness... ...Hey, 
Vivlos.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
You... actually knew all along, didn't 
you? That you weren't in good shape.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"You're a clever girl. There's no way you 
hadn't noticed."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...Because I truly thought it would be 
fine."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Trainer, got a minute?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, do you understand? The reason 
she was hiding it...
choice_data_list: Maybe she wanted to run the Tiara route

text_block_list.text:
Vivlos's desire for the Tiara route grew 
deeper by the day. She probably knew that 
speaking up now would be too late.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "...I had no idea it had gotten so heavy."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...As a senior competitor, allow me to 
share my thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
It might be better if we don't have Vivlos 
run in races.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
The Twinkle Series is a harsh world. I 
wonder if she can endure it as she is 
now...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Continuing alongside treatment is 
unrealistic. I believe it would be best to 
rest until a full recovery is made.

I was thinking along similar lines myself. 
Skip the upcoming Oka Sho and Yushun Himba 
(Japanese Oaks), and depending on the 
situation, sit out the Shuka Sho as well—
choice_data_list:
In order to advance to my biggest dream, 
Dubai—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: No way!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ! Listen to me—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely, positively running the 
Tiara route!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Because I don't want to.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
No way, I don't want to! I'm definitely 
not taking a break!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry for discussing it without 
telling you. But I intended to explain it 
properly so you would understand――"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: No! I don't wanna hear it~~!

Vivlos is usually so honest and 
obedient... Yet right now, she was being 
stubborn.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Hey, just a little bit――

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: No!! I want to win the Triple Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Because! Because, Big Sis... you can't do 
it anymore!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Huh...—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I've been watching you all this time too, 
you know? Big Sis...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Do you know how much she wanted that 
tiara...? How hard she worked for it!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
To me... you've always been number one, 
Sis! You were the coolest of all!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ! Vivlos...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...I'm not an older sister. But, I'm sure 
I'm the only one who can become one to 
her.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Everyone who loves Big Sis so much has 
entrusted their feelings to me!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'll make Big Sis's dream come true! If I 
don't, then—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise, I couldn't just have my own 
dream come true!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Vivlos...

It was a passion hidden deep inside 
Vivlos's heart that I had never known 
before. "To get revenge for my sister"... 
In those words lay an unmistakable love 
for her sister.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer-san... You understand, right?

Even with her current condition, entering 
races is possible. However, she is aiming 
for the Triple Tiara... Winning will 
require a considerable effort.

Managing her physical condition while 
getting stronger without overloading 
her... It'll demand a higher level of 
focus than ever before. It could even 
affect her future.
choice_data_list:
Even so, you're still going through with 
it?

Even so, you're still going through with 
it?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah! I'll do it!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Wait, Trainer...!
choice_data_list: Please let me work hard together with you.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...How am I supposed to trust the words 
of someone without a proven track record?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list:
If it's about Vivlos, won't you believe 
me?

If it's about Vivlos, you don't believe 
me?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Big sis...! I promise I won't do anything 
reckless!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I won't give up on the Triple Tiara or 
Dubai! That's why...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...That's not fair. If I say no now, it'll 
make it seem like I don't trust you.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Big sis...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. If anything happens to this 
girl... I will never forgive you.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Vivlos. You need to listen to what your 
Trainer tells you, too."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Because this person bears all the 
responsibility. ...That's what a trainer 
contract means. Understood?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "Trainer! ...I'm counting on you!"

The next day—Vivlos officially announced 
that she would run the Triple Tiara route 
as scheduled. The fans were overjoyed—
